ONE PRESS. ONE PUFF.

Find your rhythm.

RESTING
How to play
01

Release before trouble

Amber warms up; 40–75% green makes the best clouds. Time your puff and release as the needle approaches the end of green. Above 90% heat or below 10% liquid, output becomes smoke.

02

Compete clean. Upgrade with net vapor.

Competition Score multiplies the cloud still hanging, the largest clean puff, and cleanliness. Waiting disperses the cloud, but never reduces earned net vapor. Your net vapor payout stays separate. Only completed draws count toward largest-puff records.

Warm up → reach green → time your next puff. Match draw strength, lung capacity, wattage and airflow so one puff fits the green window. Airflow handles drawing heat. Cooling helps while resting or refilling. Rest or refill to cool, but watch your cloud disperse. Refills use reserve stock; only a new round recharges the battery.

Workshop settings

Progress, completed puffs and personal bests are saved in this browser. Gameplay pauses while the page is hidden or you browse Results and Workbench. Purchases unlock when the battery is depleted. An interrupted draw ends using only output already produced; return resting and press again. No offline production. Current personal bests and legacy competition records are saved separately. Liquid stock carries over between rounds; cloud dispersal affects competition only. Hardware has seven upgrade paths. Removed power upgrades are refunded once on migration. Existing hardware levels are preserved on Pocket One. Hardware ceilings and late-level prices now depend on the device. Operating wattage is fixed for each battery.
